projects.title: Fairness-Aware Machine Learning for Predicting Perinatal Health Outcomes
projects.description: Predictive modelling with an emphasis on fairness and explainability in perinatal health data.
details: Built a Python pipeline integrating 72 NHS Maternity Services Data Set (MSDS) datasets with multi-year ONS data. The pipeline harmonised inconsistent schemas and processed over 5.1 million records.
Compared XGBoost, Random Forest and Linear Regression, with automated hyperparameter optimisation across 80 configurations. XGBoost achieved an R² of 0.80.
Applied threshold optimisation and reweighing to reduce demographic disparity, and used SHAP and LIME to explain predictions. The classification analysis achieved approximately 82% accuracy.

projects.title: Speech Emotion Recognition using Linguistic and Acoustic Features
projects.description: A Python pipeline that classifies emotion in speech using acoustic features and rate of speech.
details: Built a pipeline using RAVDESS and CREMA-D that covers preprocessing, feature engineering, augmentation, training and evaluation.
Extracted MFCCs, zero-crossing rate, chroma, energy, statistical features and rate of speech. Augmented audio with noise injection, time shifting, time stretching and pitch changes.
Trained and evaluated CNN and MLP models. Adding the rate-of-speech feature improved CNN accuracy by up to 8%, reaching 79.4% classification accuracy.
